A Negril day in 3 stops 🗺️

1. Negril: Seven miles of sand, calm water and some of the best sunsets on the island.
2. Rick's Cafe: Grab a spot on the cliffs, catch the sunset and watch the cliff jumpers.
3. Bluefields Beach: A quiet stretch of sand on the south west coast.

Pick up at MBJ or our Montego Bay offices and drive west. Allow about 1 to 1.5 hours.

Black River Jamaica by rental car: how to get there, what to do nearby and how to book.

Black River. St Elizabeth on the water. 🌴

River, mangroves and a slow south coast pace.

Cruise the river, spot the mangroves and slow down.

Getting there: It is in St Elizabeth. Pick up at MBJ and allow about 2 hours going south.

Add Bamboo Avenue and YS Falls to make it a full south coast loop.
